fromJSON(steps.build-clusters-matrix.outputs.canary)
  = Array[Object{cluster: String, namespace: String}]

why:

    written by step 'build-clusters-matrix' (line 17):  echo "canary=$CANARY_MATRIX" >>$GITHUB_OUTPUT
      $CANARY_MATRIX (line 16):  $(yq e .canary -o=json -M $DATA_FILE | jq -c)
        file .github/workflows/data/clusters.yml parsed as YAML: Object{canary: Array[Object{cluster: String, namespace: String}], production: Array[Object{cluster: String, namespace: String}]}
        yq '.canary': Object{canary: Array[Object{…}], production: Array[Object{…}]} → Array[Object{cluster: String, namespace: String}]
        jq '.' -c: Array[Object{cluster: String, namespace: String}] → Array[Object{cluster: String, namespace: String}]
  fromJSON(String ⊂ JSON → X) = X

accepted:
  [n]            → Object{cluster: String, namespace: String}
  [n].cluster    → String
  [n].namespace  → String
  .*             → Array[Object{cluster: String, namespace: String}]
